injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Moritz Wagner
injuries.detail: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.detail: Allen (concussion) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

injuries.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
injuries.detail: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

injuries.name: Michael Ajayi
injuries.detail: Charlotte transferred Ajayi to the G League on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.detail: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Noa Essengue
injuries.detail: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: The Pacers recalled Haliburton (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Friday, per the NBA G League transaction report.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
injuries.detail: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Aday Mara
injuries.detail: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Black
injuries.detail: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
injuries.detail: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

injuries.name: Colin Castleton
injuries.detail: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.detail: James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.detail: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Rockets due to right foot plantar fasciitis management, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.detail: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
